title: Zoho Solutions Specialist
description:
We are seeking an experienced Zoho Solutions Specialist to support the implementation, configuration, development, integration, and administration of Zoho solutions across the business. This role will partner with business stakeholders, project teams, and operational teams to design, develop, implement, and support Zoho-based solutions that improve business processes, productivity, and customer outcomes. The successful candidate will combine technical expertise, business analysis, platform administration, and application support capabilities to deliver scalable and sustainable solutions within the Zoho ecosystem. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Solution Design & Business Engagement 
 Work closely with business stakeholders to gather, analyse, and document requirements. Translate business needs into practical and scalable Zoho solutions. Analyse existing business processes and identify automation opportunities. Recommend fit-for-purpose solutions across the Zoho ecosystem. Drive continuous process improvement initiatives that enhance operational efficiency and customer outcomes. 
 Platform Configuration & Development 
 Configure and enhance Zoho applications, including: Zoho CRM Zoho Desk Zoho Projects Zoho Contracts Develop custom functionality using Zoho Deluge scripting. Design and maintain workflows, approvals, automations, and business rules. Create dashboards, reports, and user-facing functionalities. Ensure solutions align with security, governance, and platform standards. 
 Integrations & Automation 
 Develop and support integrations between Zoho and internal/external systems. Build and maintain integrations using REST APIs, Webhooks, and OAuth. Support data migration, synchronisation, and automation activities. Troubleshoot integration issues and implement enhancements. Ensure all integrations are secure, reliable, and well documented. 
 Support & Continuous Improvement 
 Provide Level 2 and Level 3 support for Zoho applications. Investigate and resolve platform, workflow, and configuration issues. Liaise with Zoho Support to resolve complex technical issues. Identify opportunities to improve existing solutions and increase business value. Drive sustainable fixes to reduce recurring incidents. 
 Delivery & Governance 
 Support testing, deployment, and release activities. Maintain technical documentation and configuration records. Ensure solutions comply with governance, security, and platform standards. Support smooth transition of solutions from project delivery into Business-as-Usual (BAU) operations. Track risks, dependencies, and delivery milestones to successful completion. 
 Required Skills & Experience 
 Essential 3-5+ years of hands-on experience working with the Zoho platform. Strong experience with Zoho CRM. Strong proficiency in Deluge Scripting. Experience designing workflows, automations, and business processes. Experience developing and supporting REST API Integrations. Knowledge of Webhooks, OAuth, and integration patterns. Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills. Ability to work directly with business stakeholders and translate requirements into effective solutions. 
 Desirable Experience with: Zoho Desk Zoho Projects Zoho Contracts Zoho Creator Zoho Flow Zoho People Zoho Analytics Experience administering SaaS platforms. Exposure to Agile project delivery methodologies. Experience with AI, automation, or Microsoft Copilot-related solutions. Zoho certifications.

title: Salesforce QA Professional
description:
We are seeking a detail-oriented and motivated Salesforce QA with 1-3 years of experience to ensure the quality and functionality of our Salesforce implementations. The ideal candidate will have a foundational understanding of QA methodologies and a keen interest in the Salesforce platform. 

Roles and Responsibilty 

Salesforce Platform Knowledge 

Understanding of Salesforce architecture, objects, fields, relationships, workflows, validation rules, and page layouts. 

Familiarity with Salesforce features such as Process Builder, Lightning Components, and Salesforce security model. 

Manual Testing Skills 

Test Case Development: Ability to create detailed, comprehensive, and well-structured test cases. 

Test Execution: Proficiency in executing test cases and documenting the results. 

Defect Tracking: Skills in logging, tracking, and managing defects using tools like Jira or Bugzilla. 

Regression Testing: Experience in performing regression testing to ensure new changes do not adversely affect existing functionalities. 

Positive Testing: Ensuring the system functions as expected under normal conditions. 

Negative Testing: Ensuring the system gracefully handles invalid or unexpected inputs. 

Error Handling: Verification that errors are correctly handled and communicated, including the generation of appropriate error messages and emails. 

Requirement Analysis 

Ability to understand and analyze business requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria to develop test plans and strategies. 

User Interface (UI) Testing 

Skills in testing the Salesforce user interface, including checking for usability, consistency, and adherence to design specifications. 

Data Validation and Verification 

Proficiency in validating and verifying data integrity, consistency, and correctness within Salesforce objects. 

Basic SOQL Knowledge 

Understanding of basic SOQL queries to verify data in Salesforce-related databases. 

Excel Sheet Knowledge 

Proficiency in using Excel for data handling, including: 

Data import/export: Importing data into Salesforce and exporting data from Salesforce to Excel. 

Data manipulation: Using Excel functions to clean, sort, filter, and analyze data. 

Data visualization: Creating charts and graphs to visualize data for reporting purposes. 

Requirements: 

Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field. 

1-3 years of experience in Salesforce QA testing, including configurations, custom code, and integrations. 

Basic understanding of Salesforce platform features and functionality. 

Familiarity with QA tools and methodologies, including automated testing tools. 

Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills. 

Strong communication and collaboration abilities. 

Salesforce certifications (e.g., Salesforce Certified Administrator) are a plus. 

Experience with Agile/Scrum development processes is beneficial.

Key Skills: Salesforce,SOQL,Regression Testing,salesforce QA,Defect tracking,Analysis,salesforce objects,Salesforce Security Model
